question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "that"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given passage, the most appropriate option for blank no.4 is 'that.'
 
• It is a pronoun.
 
• A pronoun is a word that takes place of a noun.
 
 
• ​Example: I closed **that** bank
